version.changelog:
Cookbook Forge 1.0.0: initial release — generates deep technical CookBooks, Handbooks, and Surveys from multi-source materials, outputting to MDX, ElegantBook PDF, Nextra site, and optimized EPUB.

- Converts user materials (websites, PDFs, EPUBs, GitHub, arxiv, docs) into chaptered MDX, then to LaTeX/PDF, website, or EPUB.
- Follows O'Reilly CookBook and Springer Handbook styles; rich support for technical diagrams and code.
- Flexible output: MDX (default), ElegantBook LaTeX/PDF, Nextra v3 website, and EPUB, each in their own subdirectory.
- Automated, exhaustive collection of resources, including browser and CLI skills/tooling for web, code, and document parsing.
- Comprehensive workflow: input parsing, resource gathering, outline design with user confirmation, chaptered MDX writing, and multi-format export.
- Includes scripts/assets for font subsetting, formula image optimization, PDF/EPUB/website build pipelines, and standardized templates.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed documentation-book generator whose file, web, build, and publishing-related actions are aligned with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Network access, npm installs, Docker, XeLaTeX, OCR/parsing tools, and optional remote Kroki rendering are proportionate for producing documentation artifacts, but users should avoid pointing it at sensitive private directories unless intended.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact contains only SKILL.md and no executable bundled scripts, installers, or manifest-time code, although the text references scripts/assets that are not present in the package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow can read user-provided local files, repositories, and relevant local skill files, and may perform broad web research; it includes user outline confirmation, source tracking, and an explicit prohibition on publishing or committing without user request.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill creates project output directories and may start a Docker Compose site for validation, but it shows no hidden persistence, privilege escalation, credential/session harvesting, destructive behavior, or unauthorized publishing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to generate technical cookbooks/handbooks from user-provided sources and convert them to MDX, PDF, Nextra, and EPUB; the requested tools for web research, GitHub reading, PDF/EPUB parsing, diagram rendering, and build steps fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install if you want an agent to research and generate large technical documentation projects. Before use, be clear about which local folders and documents it may read, avoid confidential diagrams with remote Kroki rendering, and review any Docker/npm build actions or generated site deployment steps before running them.
